summary:
P3 examples complete — AlembicCore commit 16b775e on main (no push/tag/version bump). The four shipped EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES were anti-examples that FAILED the gate; they are now real, gate-passing, multi-language worked examples living in the module.

P3.1 DOWN-MOVE (C.9 internal-only): EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES moved from MissionBriefingSupport.ts (~106-213) into the RecipeAuthoringSpec module (recipe-authoring-spec/examples/index.ts). It is NOT re-exported through the host-agent-workflows facade — grep-proven: MissionBriefingSupport now has 0 EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES, and BOTH dist/host-agent-workflows.d.ts and dist/knowledge.d.ts mention it 0 times (only example() is public). MissionBriefingBuilder now injects recipeExample(lang).candidate (was EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES[lang] || [lang.toLowerCase()] || _default). The examples module imports only a types-layer type (RecipeAuthoringViolation) — zero workflows-layer imports (the line-145 hit is example DATA, a string).

C.5 ANTI-EXAMPLE FIXES (every example built by buildExample so the invariants hold structurally):
- CONTENT_CONTRAST_MISSING: the ✅/❌ lines now carry ≥4 non-space chars after the marker (e.g. "✅ correct: @interface BDVideoPlayer : UIView") — before, "// ✅ 正确" left only 2 trimmed chars (正确), below the 4-char floor.
- DO_CLAUSE/DONT_CLAUSE_NON_IMPERATIVE: objectivec doClause now leads with "Use" (was "Prefix", not allowlisted) and dontClause with "Do not" (was "create", not a negative verb).
- SOURCE_REF_LINE_MISSING (also latent): reasoning.sources + sourceRefs now carry line numbers (BDVideoPlayer.h:5) — before they were bare filenames, which fail the stage-2 source-ref line-format check on a pure run.

P3.2 LANGUAGES: added swift, kotlin, java, go, rust, csharp, javascript (+ existing objectivec/typescript/python) and grew _default to gate-passing — unlisted languages now fall to a gate-clean _default.

P3.3 INJECTION: Core MissionBriefingBuilder keeps its injection via example(); the in-process main-body ColdStartWorkflow/KnowledgeRescanWorkflow injection is NOT in Core (Core has no such workflows — they live in the Plugin/AlembicAgent), so it is a follow-up carry-item (ai-scan carved out per the task).

C.5 STANDING TRIPWIRE: test/RecipeAuthoringSpecExamplesGatePassing.test.ts runs EVERY example(lang) (all 11 templates incl _default + known/unknown resolution) through validateAgainst({stage:'all'}) and asserts ZERO violations — the structural opposite of the anti-examples, forever. The gate was NEVER relaxed to pass a bad example; the examples were fixed.

ACCEPTANCE (node 22.22.1): build:check PASS; the tripwire PASS (13 tests — every example, all languages incl _default, passes the full gate); briefing tests PASS (MissionBriefingBuilder injection intact); npm run check boundary OK (61 exports; wildcard stayed 7; removed-export-resurrection + shrink-only passed — removing EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES from the wildcard host-agent-workflows facade needed NO snapshot change, no leak); full Core suite 1495/1495 (156 files); biome 684 files clean (fixed a noTemplateCurlyInString in the js example by using string concat). npm run check red ONLY on the 3 pre-existing out-of-scope lint:naming files (carve-out; not touched).
verification: npm run build → PASS (dist rebuilt; used to grep-prove the facade .d.ts)
vitest test/RecipeAuthoringSpecExamplesGatePassing.test.ts → PASS 13 (every EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES[lang] + example(known/unknown) passes validateAgainst({stage:'all'}) with zero violations)
npm run test → 1495/1495 PASS (156 files); briefing tests (DimensionCatalogPayload etc.) green — MissionBriefingBuilder injection intact
npm run lint (biome) → 684 files clean (noTemplateCurlyInString warning fixed via string concat in the js example)
npm run check → lint:public-api-boundary OK (61 exports, wildcard<=7 (7), removed-export-resurrection passed); all stages PASS except lint:naming red ONLY on the 3 pre-existing files

C.9 grep proof: examples/index.ts imports only types-layer RecipeAuthoringViolation (zero workflows imports); MissionBriefingSupport EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES count=0; dist/host-agent-workflows.d.ts + dist/knowledge.d.ts EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES count=0 (no facade leak)
risks: P3.3 in-process injection (follow-up carry-item, NOT Core): the in-process main-body ColdStartWorkflow/KnowledgeRescanWorkflow example injection lives in the Plugin/AlembicAgent (Core has no such workflows), so it is out of this Core task's scope per the task itself (ai-scan carved out). Core's MissionBriefingBuilder injection IS done via example(). Recommend the in-process example injection be confirmed/added in the Plugin/Agent windows.

Boundary snapshot: removing EXAMPLE_TEMPLATES from the host-agent-workflows wildcard facade needed NO snapshot/config change — it was a wildcard member (not an individually-tracked exact export), so wildcard count stayed 7 and removed-export-resurrection passed. The 'intentionally update the snapshot' step was a no-op in practice.

The examples now carry stage-2-grade evidence (line-numbered sourceRefs + reasoning.sources) so they pass a pure (resolver-free) validateAgainst({stage:'all'}); this is intentional (gate-clean), not gate relaxation — the gate is byte-identical from P1 and untouched.
Gate NEVER relaxed: the tripwire proves the examples pass the real gate; any future anti-example reintroduction fails the tripwire loudly.
Commit 16b775e is local only (no push), per main-only/no-push; controller verification is local.
